question: Does the Jetstream2 access page statement of 2 SU per vCPU-hour for GPU flavours still hold, given the flavour table lists L40S and H100 flavours at flat 84 and 128 SU per hour?
why: The flavour table rows g4.xl (12 vCPU, 84 SU) and g5.xl (20 vCPU, 128 SU) do not equal 2 SU per vCPU; the access-page evidence row of compute/jetstream2 still carries the 2 SU claim.
